Entry 1 uses substrate 1a (Boc-Gly-OH) and the reported yield (column labeled '3b') is assumed to correspond to product 3a. Stereochemistry for substrates 1b and products 3b is assumed to be the L-configuration (S) as drawn, consistent with standard amino acid chemistry. Footnote c (entry 6) indicates dr > 99:1. Footnote d (entry 13) specifies the reaction was performed without 5 Å molecular sieves.

parts.text: Extract every reaction in this figure (filename: ACScat_2020.pdf_page002_table_01_s0.88.png).
